gui.xaero-world-map-book.config.title: Xaero World Map Book Settings
gui.xaero-world-map-book.config.close_to: Close this screen. Prompts to save first if anything is unsaved.
gui.xaero-world-map-book.config.reset_se: Reset every setting back to its default.
gui.xaero-world-map-book.config.allow_re: If enabled, non-operator players can view (but never change) these settings. JSON key: allowNonOpReadOnlyView
gui.xaero-world-map-book.config.admin_no: You do not have operator permission to view these settings.
gui.xaero-world-map-book.config.admin_re: You do not have operator permission to change these settings.
gui.xaero-world-map-book.confirm_save.me: You have unsaved changes. What would you like to do?
gui.xaero-world-map-book.confirm_save.sa: Save every pending change, then close this screen.
gui.xaero-world-map-book.confirm_save.cl: Discard every pending change and close this screen.
gui.xaero-world-map-book.confirm_save.ca: Return to the settings screen with every pending change intact.
gui.xaero-world-map-book.map_access_deni: The World Map keybind is disabled on this server.
You need an Atlas in your hotbar to open the World Map.
You need an Atlas in your inventory to open the World Map.
You need to craft or obtain an Atlas to open the World Map.
gui.xaero-world-map-book.mapaccess.keybi: Whether the gated keybind can open the World Map at all. JSON key: keybindOpenEnabled
Where the Atlas must be for the gated keybind to work. JSON key: keybindItemRequirement
gui.xaero-world-map-book.mapaccess.minim: Where the Atlas must be for the Minimap to be visible, on top of having earned the Atlas. JSON key: minimapAccessRequirement
gui.xaero-world-map-book.mapaccess.chunk: Distinct chunks a player must visit, after earning the Atlas, to earn unrestricted Minimap access. JSON key: chunksRequiredForWellTraveled
gui.xaero-world-map-book.mapaccess.minim: Which advancement satisfies Advancement Only mode for the Minimap Access Requirement above. JSON key: minimapAdvancementGate
gui.xaero-world-map-book.mapaccess.creat: If enabled, players in Creative mode skip every Atlas/advancement requirement for both the gated keybind and the Minimap. JSON key: creativeBypassEnabled
